<plan>1. Use Do to defeat the zombie and unlock “Defeat Zombie”.  
2. Move west to the nearby grass tile and Do to collect wood, achieving “Collect Wood”.  
3. From the grass square, walk to a flat tile that is one step north of the point (current_x-3, current_y-4); face north and use Place Table to lay the table in front, satisfying “Place Table”.  
4. While standing facing the table, invoke Make Wood Pickaxe; inventory Wood+Table gives the pickaxe, earning “Make Wood Pickaxe”.  
5. Retrace to the original location and Do on the stone blocks that are 3 steps south; each Do collects a stone and the “Collect Stone” achievement is reached.  
6. Put the collected stone next to the table, then use Make Stone Pickaxe to craft it, completing “Make Stone Pickaxe”.  
7. Place a stone block in front of the table: Move to a tile with a flat surface directly north of the table and place Stone, unlocking “Place Stone”.  
8. Move to the 7‑step southeast area: Do on coal blocks to gather coal, achieving “Collect Coal”.  
9. With the stone pickaxe, move to a flat spot east of the table and place a Furnace using Place Furnace, achieving “Place Furnace”.  
10. Harvest iron ore when discovered (Do on iron blocks), achieving “Collect Iron”.  
11. Use Make Iron Pickaxe at the table with furnace, wood, coal, iron, earning “Make Iron Pickaxe”.  
12. Search for a skeleton; Do on the skeleton to defeat it, giving “Defeat Skeleton”.  
13. Use Make Iron Sword at the table with iron pickaxe, “Make Iron Sword”.  
14. Move to a plant tile, Do to plant and then Do on it to eat, getting “Collect Plant” and “Eat Plant”.  
15. Find a lake to Do for water, gaining “Collect Drink”.  
16. Move to the 5‑step southeast diamond area and Do on the diamond, completing “Collect Diamond”.  
17. If a cow appears, use Do to eat it for “Eat Cow”.  
18. After all achievements are satisfied, Sleep if energy falls below maximum to refresh.  
All actions are taken step by step, focusing first on defeating the zombie, gathering wood, placing the table, then sequentially collecting resources, crafting tools, defeating the skeleton, and finally collecting the diamond.  
Once the plan is implemented, the agent will achieve all listed game achievements.
